verdict.rationale: Quo is a hosted SaaS business phone platform. Self-hosting is a fair question for communications software, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises deployment: the pack covers only the hosted API at api.quo.com, a public MCP server, and apps on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Web.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
